name: processtask_step_diagram
label: Work Order and Architecture Diagram Relationship
description: Work orders are related to the architecture diagrams and can be used for association queries related to workflows and other reporting scenarios.

fields.name: processtask_id
fields.description: Work order ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: processtask_step_id
fields.description: Work order step ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: cientity_id

fields.name: diagram_id
fields.description: Architecture diagram ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: diagram_version_id

fields.name: system
fields.description: Application system. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
